Liu Xuan'ang

Undergraduate Student · Nanjing University Incoming PhD Student · Shanghai Jiao Tong University, 2027

I am an undergraduate student in the School of Integrated Circuits at Nanjing University, majoring in Integrated Circuit Design and Integrated Systems. My undergraduate research focuses on AI efficiency, especially quantization. In 2027, I will begin a PhD in Intelligent Science and Technology at Shanghai Jiao Tong University, advised by Professor Shaobo Cui. My doctoral research direction is world models.
